title: Uniform lower-tail amplitude of proper direct image on the qcqs constructible finite-Tor hull
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside a fixed algebraic closure, and an admissible commutative condensed ring $\Lambda$: a finite commutative ring annihilated by a power of $\ell$, or $\mathbf Z_\ell,\mathcal O_E,\mathbf Q_\ell,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, with exactly the discrete or induced $\ell$-adic topological condensed-ring convention of [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ and $D_T=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T})$, the ordinary unbounded module-object derived category [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], with the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Use the finite constant scalar-model constructibility and finite Tor amplitude of [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Let $S$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme, $q:Y\to S$ proper and $f:X\to Y$ proper. Write $\mathcal L_X=\operatorname{Loc}(\mathrm D_{\mathrm{ctf}}(X,\Lambda))$ for the full replete triangulated hull closed under small coproducts in $D_X$ [sk-def-localizing-closure]. There exists $c\in\mathbf N$, independent of $a$ and $K$, such that for every $a\in\mathbf Z$ and every $K\in\mathcal L_X$,
$$H^r\bigl(Rf_*\tau_{<a}K\bigr)=0\qquad(r\geq a+c).$$
Here $\tau_{<a}=\tau_{\leq a-1}$ is the standard good truncation [def-kun-truncations]. The truncation and $Rf_*$ are taken in the ordinary ambient derived categories; the truncated object is not required to remain in $\mathcal L_X$. In particular, the assertion concerns lower tails which need not be derived complete. No field, characteristic, Noetherian or finite-dimensional-base hypothesis is imposed.
